svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rack 1200 x 600 x 1800 mm: four posts of 40 x 40 x 3 SHS,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1800 long, tied at top and bottom by the tray runners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Runners: 25 x 25 x 3 angle welded across the posts at 160 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pitch, ten levels from 200 mm up (top tray at 1640).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Trays (make 10): 1120 x 600 frames of 25 x 25 x 3 angle with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stainless mesh, about 2 mm aperture, riveted in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fan stand: base plate 500 x 300 x 10, post of 60 x 60 x 3 SHS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 590 long welded on; fan bolted on top, axis 900 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rack on the floor, 120 mm from the front wall; fan stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in front, fan face 100 mm from the trays, blowing through them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every tray slides out with one hand when full.
